text: but it's ridiculous now. So somebody's going to say, well, Nikki, what are we going to do with these people that commit these crimes? I don't know. I'm just a poet. I don't have to know. But I do know this. What I know is not a good idea. I don't have to pretend it's okay because I don't have another solution. I know we can do better. I know that whatever it is, I know prison is a bad idea because people build prisons and they build these big buildings way out in the middle of nowhere with all of these gates and they put people in them and they're supposed to what? Come back 20 years from now sane
